title: Gaussian-process surrogate indicators for residual-based adaptive GMsFEM
summary: Residual-based adaptive GMsFEM for high-contrast elliptic problems repeatedly evaluates local weighted $H^{-1}$ indicators on every coarse neighborhood, making indicator evaluation a recurring cost in repeated-query settings. We introduce a non-intrusive Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate for the indicator scores used in Dörfler marking.
